problem_description: Evaluate the definite integral of x·sin(2x) with respect to x from 0 to π/8.

prerequisites.reason: The integrand is a product of a polynomial term (x) and a trigonometric function (sin(2x)), which is a standard situation for applying integration by parts.
The limits 0 and π/8 must be applied to the antiderivative once it is found.
Knowledge of the antiderivative of sin(2x) and related trigonometric identities assists in solving the integral.

givens.known_facts: The integral is definite with lower limit 0 and upper limit π/8.
givens.explanation: These limits will be substituted after finding the antiderivative.
Recognizing the form helps in choosing the appropriate integration technique.
